---
name: vibeschool-activation-authority
description: Keep VibeSchool runtime, scheduler, publishing, payment and consequential authority commissioning separate from coding and merge authority.
---
# Activation Authority
Coding, testing, review, repair and merge permission never imply commissioning authority. Worker/Cyborg runtime, scheduler/heartbeat automation, automatic publishing, payments and consequential authority remain default-denied unless explicit current authorization plus required commissioning evidence exists. Preserve Global Stop and equivalent fail-closed controls. Report code readiness separately from runtime activation state.
